title: done accepts the _sources.csv used-in column a fact in the item's touched articles regenerates
goal: When an item's commit adds a source id to a touched article's sources header, done accepts the matching kb/public/_sources.csv used-in change without a touches widening, so BG-6w4zexka's landing in SP-uvz65lvm would not have refused at outside-touches

run:
import sys, tempfile, os, io, contextlib, subprocess, argparse, json
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_land
hdr = 'id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by\n'
def go(header):
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    def g(*a):
        return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    def w(p, t):
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d, p)), exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(d, p), 'w').write(t)
    g('init', '-q')
    g('config', 'user.email', 'a@b.c')
    g('config', 'user.name', 'n')
    w('backlog.json', json.dumps(dict(docs_map='')))
    w('kb/public/_root.md', 'root\n')
    w('kb/public/_sources.csv', hdr + 'S1,https://example.com/a,A,P,MIT,copy,2026-01-01,v1,,arch/a.md,\nS2,https://example.com/b,B,P,MIT,copy,2026-01-01,v1,,,\n')
    w('kb/public/arch/a.md', '---\ntopic: arch/a\nsources: [S1]\n---\n# A\n')
    g('add', '-A')
    g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'base')
    w('kb/public/_sources.csv', hdr + 'S1,https://example.com/a,A,P,MIT,copy,2026-01-01,v1,,arch/a.md,\nS2,https://example.com/b,B,P,MIT,copy,2026-01-01,v1,,arch/a.md,\n')
    w('kb/public/arch/a.md', '---\ntopic: arch/a\nsources: ' + header + '\n---\n# A\nA fact. [DOC S2]\n')
    g('add', '-A')
    g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'work\n\nKB-Work: BG-bbbbbbbb')
    bl_base.load_settings(d)
    bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
    bl.items['BG-bbbbbbbb'] = dict(id='BG-bbbbbbbb', kind='bug', title='t', status='todo', goal='g', touches=['kb/public/arch/a.md'], checks=[dict(run=['true'])])
    out = io.StringIO()
    msg = ''
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out):
            bl_land.cmd_done(bl, argparse.Namespace(id='BG-bbbbbbbb', dry_run=True, commit=False, trailer=[]))
    except Exception as e:
        msg = str(e)
    return 'is not done' in msg and any('outside touches' in l and '_sources.csv' in l for l in msg.splitlines())
accepted = not go('[S1, S2]')
kept = go('[S1]')
sys.exit(0 if accepted and kept else 1)

notes: SP-uvz65lvm retrospective finding (2026-10-13), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
